subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers choose this stale-internal-drop strategy or the preserve-as-context strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical fix for the queued/orphaned stale-reply issue?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same canonical issue but intentionally differ on model-visible session-state semantics, and automation cannot safely choose that runtime contract.

options.title: Choose the proven preserve-as-context PR
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 if maintainers prefer preserving orphaned older user text as context-only with its stronger runtime proof.

options.title: Require proof for this drop strategy
options.body: Keep this PR active and ask for real embedded-agent proof if maintainers prefer dropping selected internal handoff leaves when a fresh prompt exists.

options.title: Request a combined or narrowed repair
options.body: Pause both branches if neither predicate captures the desired session-state contract cleanly.

recommendation.title: Choose the proven preserve-as-context PR
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 if maintainers prefer preserving orphaned older user text as context-only with its stronger runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65478.
